neighbours.label: a sentence-level comment on expectation or surprise ('as might be expected', 'surprisingly', 'believe it or not', 'predictably')
fire: The match was close. As one would expect, the home side was nervous.
The tests came back, and predictably, the cheaper model broke first.
The recipe uses no sugar, yet, believe it or not, the cake is sweet.
Unsurprisingly, the train was late again on Monday.
The dog, as you can imagine, was thrilled to see the snow.
Oddly enough, the smallest seedlings grew the fastest.
As might be expected from such an old house, the pipes leak.
Remarkably, the old clock still keeps perfect time.
quiet: The match was close. The home side was nervous in the first half.
The tests came back, and the cheaper model broke first.
The recipe uses no sugar, yet the cake is still a little sweet.
The train was late again on Monday morning.
The dog was thrilled to see the snow in the yard.
The smallest seedlings grew the fastest in the shade.
The pipes leak in the old house on the hill.
The old clock still keeps perfect time on the shelf.
